info.title: Danish Law Service API
info.description: API for Danish legal documents from retsinformation.dk

get.description:
List legislative bills (Lovforslag) with filters.

- search: Search in title
- status: Filter by status (Vedtaget, Forkastet, etc.)
- periode_id: Filter by parliamentary period
- enacted: Filter by enacted status (true = enacted into law, false = not enacted)
- ressort: Filter by ministry

**Field translations**: Danish FT ODA fields are translated to English.
See response schema for original field names (e.g., "nummer" → "number").

Get a legislative bill by number.

The number can be provided as "L-123" (URL-friendly) or "L 123".

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/bills/L-123

Get the legislative process steps for a bill.

Returns the progression through the legislative process (Sagstrin).
A typical Lovforslag goes through these phases:

**Legislative Lifecycle**:
1. Fremsat (Introduced) - Initial bill submission
2. 1. behandling (First Reading) - Initial debate
3. Henvist til udvalg (Committee Referral) - Assigned to committee
4. Betænkning (Committee Report) - Committee findings published
5. 2. behandling (Second Reading) - Detailed debate with amendments
6. 3. behandling (Third Reading) - Final vote
7. Resolution - Vedtaget (Passed), Forkastet (Rejected), or Bortfaldet (Lapsed)

Each step has a status_id and date tracking its completion.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/bills/L-123/steps

Get actors involved in a bill with their roles.

Returns politicians, committees, and ministries involved via the SagAktør
junction table, including their roles.

**Common Actor Types**:
- Person (typeid=5) - Individual MPs
- Udvalg (typeid=5) - Parliamentary committees
- Ministerium - Ministries

**Common Case-Actor Roles (23 types)**:
- Forslagsstiller - Bill sponsor (initiator)
- Ordfører - Spokesperson (party representative)
- Minister for ressortministeriet - Responsible minister
- Medunderskriver - Co-signer
- Udvalg - Committee handling the case

Each actor entry includes role_id and role for their specific involvement.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/bills/L-123/actors

Get documents related to a bill.

Returns document metadata and URLs (not the actual file content).
The FT ODA API provides 28 different document types.

**Key Document Types for Lovforslag**:
- Lovforslag som fremsat - The original bill text
- Bemærkninger - Explanatory notes
- Betænkning - Committee report
- Tillægsbetænkning - Supplementary committee report
- Ændringsforslag - Amendments
- Lovforslag som vedtaget - The enacted law text

**Document Fields**:
- file_url (FT: filurl) - Direct PDF download URL
- html_url (FT: htmlurl) - HTML version URL
- document_type (FT: type) - Document type name
- date (FT: dato) - Document date

- document_type: Filter by document type

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/bills/L-123/documents

Get the enacted law for a bill (if it passed).

Returns the LawDocument that this bill became when enacted.
Returns 404 if the bill has not been enacted into law.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/bills/L-123/enacted-law

schema.title: Response Get Enacted Law V1 Lovgivning Bills  Number  Enacted Law Get

get.description:
Get keywords (Emneord) for a bill.

Returns topic tags associated with this bill.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/bills/L-123/keywords

Get all text content from a bill.

Returns aggregated text content fields from the parliamentary case,
including the summary (resume), decision text, voting conclusion,
background material, and justification.

**Available Text Fields**:
- resume: Main case summary (FT: resume)
- decision_text: Decision description (FT: afgørelse)
- voting_conclusion: Voting conclusion (FT: afstemningskonklusion)
- background_material: Background information (FT: baggrundsmateriale)
- justification: Reasoning/justification (FT: begrundelse)

**Note**: This returns structured metadata text from FT ODA, not the
full legislative document text. For the actual bill document (PDF),
use the `/documents` endpoint to get file URLs.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/bills/L-123/text

Get actors who participated at a specific legislative step.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/bills/L-123/steps/234567/actors

Get documents submitted at a specific legislative step.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/bills/L-123/steps/234567/documents

Get files for a specific document.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/bills/L-123/documents/456789/files

List all parliamentary cases with filters.

Unlike /bills/ which only returns Lovforslag, this endpoint returns
all 13 case types from the FT ODA API.

**Case Types (13 types)**:
- Lovforslag (L) - Legislative bills
- Beslutningsforslag (B) - Resolution bills
- Aktstykker - Budgetary documents
- Alm. del - General case files
- Forespørgsler - Interpellations
- Redegørelser - Reports/statements
- § 20-spørgsmål - Section 20 questions
- § 71-tilsyn - Section 71 oversight
- Samrådsspørgsmål - Consultation questions
- Skriftlige spørgsmål - Written questions
- Statsrevisorspørgsmål - Public accounts questions
- Undersøgelseskommissioner - Investigation commissions
- EU-noter - EU notes

**Status System** (~68 values):
Common status values: Fremsat, Vedtaget, Forkastet, Bortfaldet,
Henvist til udvalg, 1./2./3. behandling afsluttet

- search: Search in title
- status: Filter by status
- periode_id: Filter by parliamentary period
- ressort: Filter by ministry
- case_type: Filter by case type

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/cases/?case_type=Beslutningsforslag

Get a case by its FT API ID.

This endpoint uses the FT ODA API ID (integer), which is universal
across all case types.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/cases/234567

Get the legislative process steps for a case by FT ID.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/cases/234567/steps

Get actors involved in a case by FT ID.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/cases/234567/actors

Get documents for a case by FT ID.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/cases/234567/documents

Get keywords (Emneord) for a case by FT ID.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/cases/234567/keywords

Get all text content from a case by FT ID.

Returns aggregated text content fields from the parliamentary case.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/cases/234567/text

Get actors who participated at a specific legislative step (by FT ID).

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/cases/123456/steps/234567/actors

Get documents submitted at a specific legislative step (by FT ID).

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/cases/123456/steps/234567/documents

List all keywords (Emneord).

Keywords (Emneord) are topic tags assigned to cases and documents
for subject-based classification and retrieval.

**Use Cases**:
- Find all cases related to a specific topic (e.g., "klima", "sundhed")
- Analyze legislative activity by policy area
- Cross-reference cases by shared keywords

**Keyword Assignment**:
- Cases have keywords via SagEmneord junction
- Documents have keywords via DokumentEmneord junction

- search: Search in keyword text
- keyword_type: Filter by keyword type

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/keywords/?search=klima

Get a keyword by its FT API ID.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/keywords/12345

Get all cases that have a specific keyword.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/keywords/12345/cases

List all actors (persons, committees, ministries, parties).

The FT ODA API provides 13 different actor types representing all
participants in the parliamentary process.

**Actor Types (13 types)**:
- Person - Individual MPs and other persons
- Udvalg - Parliamentary committees (key for case processing)
- Ministerium - Ministries
- Ministerområde - Ministry areas
- Folketinget - Parliament
- Regering - Government
- Organisation - Organizations
- Interesse organisation - Interest groups
- Parlamentarisk gruppe - Parliamentary groups
- Revisionsudvalg - Audit committees
- Parti - Political parties
- Embedsmand - Civil servants
- Andre - Others

**Committee Identification**:
Committees (Udvalg) handle case reviews. Filter with actor_type=Udvalg
to find all active committees.

- search: Search in actor name
- actor_type: Filter by actor type

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/actors/?actor_type=Person

Get an actor by FT API ID.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/actors/12345

Get all relationships for an actor.

Returns relationships where this actor is the "from" actor.
Use /memberships to get party and committee memberships.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/actors/12345/relationships

Get party and committee memberships for an actor.

Returns relationships from the AktørAktør table tracking memberships
over time with start/end dates.

**Membership Types**:
- Party memberships - Which political party an MP belongs to
- Committee memberships - Which committees an MP serves on

**Time Tracking**:
Each membership has start_date and end_date fields, allowing historical
analysis of committee composition and party affiliations over time.

- active_only: If true, only return currently active memberships
  (where end_date is null or in the future)

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/actors/12345/memberships

List parliamentary periods.

Parliamentary work is organized by periods (Periode) which define
the timeframe for legislative sessions.

**Period Types**:
- Folketingsår - Parliamentary year (main period type)
- Samling - Parliamentary session within a year

**Period Naming**:
Periods are typically named like "2024-25" (Folketingsår) or
"2024-25 (1. samling)" (Samling).

**Use Cases**:
- Filter cases by periode_id to get cases from a specific session
- Use /current to get the active parliamentary period
- Historical analysis of legislative activity by period

- type_filter: Filter by period type (Folketingsår, Samling)
- active_only: Only return currently active periods

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/perioder/?type_filter=Folketingsår

Get the current parliamentary period.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/perioder/current

Get a parliamentary period by FT API ID.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/perioder/159

Retrieve laws with optional search and filters.

- search: Danish full-text search across title, short_name, popular_title,
  and the law body. Supports phrases ("…") and -negation.
- year: Filter by year
- ressort: Filter by ressort
- historical: Filter by historical status (true = historical, false = current).
  For name-style queries this defaults to false unless explicitly set.
- document_type: Filter by document type (LOVH, LBKH, BEK, etc.)
- sort: See parameter description.
- include_amendments: See parameter description.

parameters.name: sort

schema.description: Sort field with optional `-` prefix for descending. Allowed: signature_date, publication_date, effective_date, title, year, number. Default: -signature_date. When `search` is set and `sort` is omitted, results are ranked by relevance.
schema.title: Sort

parameters.description: Sort field with optional `-` prefix for descending. Allowed: signature_date, publication_date, effective_date, title, year, number. Default: -signature_date. When `search` is set and `sort` is omitted, results are ranked by relevance.

parameters.name: include_amendments

schema.description: Whether to include amendment laws (titles starting with 'Lov om ændring af …'). Defaults to True except for short alphabetic name queries (e.g. ?search=straffeloven), where amendments are filtered out so the canonical law surfaces. Pass true to opt back in.
schema.title: Include Amendments

parameters.description: Whether to include amendment laws (titles starting with 'Lov om ændring af …'). Defaults to True except for short alphabetic name queries (e.g. ?search=straffeloven), where amendments are filtered out so the canonical law surfaces. Pass true to opt back in.

get.description:
Resolve a law name to a single (year, number) — one-shot lookup.

Use this instead of GET / when you have a name and need an ID, not a
list. Returns the freshest active LBKH (consolidation) for the name.

Status codes:
  * 200 — single confident match.
  * 300 — multiple candidates within ambiguity delta (body lists them).
  * 404 — nothing above the confidence floor.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Name to resolve to a single (year, number). Case-insensitive. Tries exact short_name/popular_title match first, then trigram similarity (pg_trgm).
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Name to resolve to a single (year, number). Case-insensitive. Tries exact short_name/popular_title match first, then trigram similarity (pg_trgm).

300.description: Multiple candidate matches; pick one explicitly.

404.description: No law name matches the query above the confidence floor.

get.description:
Get a specific law by year and number.

Returns version 1 (the original/base law) with full structure and metadata.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2025/468

Query parameters:
- include: Comma-separated list of FT ODA data to include.
          Options: case, actors, timeline, full (all of the above)
          Example: ?include=case,actors

schema.title: Response Get Law By Year Number V1 Lovgivning  Year   Number  Get

get.description:
Get the parliamentary cases that led to this enacted law.

Returns all cases (typically Lovforslag) that were enacted into this
specific law. Most laws will have exactly one case, but some may have
multiple (e.g., consolidated acts with amendments).

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2024/123/cases

Get the legislative history for an enacted law.

Returns the parliamentary case (typically Lovforslag) that led to this
enacted law, along with all legislative process steps. Step types are
resolved from a static mapping if null in the database.

The response includes a link to ft.dk for viewing the full case details.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2024/123/legislative-history

Get actors associated with this enacted law.

Returns all actors (Forslagsstiller, Minister, Ordfører, etc.) that were
involved in creating this law, as recorded from the FT ODA case data.

Actor roles:
- Forslagsstiller: Bill sponsor/proposer
- Minister: Responsible minister
- Ordfører: Parliamentary spokesperson
- Ministerområde: Ministry area (policy domain)
- Udvalg: Committee that processed the case

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2024/123/actors

Get a specific law as markdown.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2025/468/markdown

Query parameters:
- exclude: Comma-separated sections to exclude
          ('preamble', 'signature', 'appendices', 'case_history')
- paragraphs: Paragraph filter ('1-5' for range, '10,15,20' for specific)

Get a specific law as PDF.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2025/468/pdf

Query parameters:
- exclude: Comma-separated sections to exclude
          ('preamble', 'signature', 'appendices', 'case_history')
- paragraphs: Paragraph filter ('1-5' for range, '10,15,20' for specific)
- include_forarbejder: Include preparatory remarks section (default: false)

Get the full retsinformation timeline for a law.

Returns the complete chronological chain of documents (historical LBKs,
amendment LOVs, original LOV Hs) from retsinformation.dk.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2025/1294/timeline

schema.title: Response Get Law Timeline V1 Lovgivning  Year   Number  Timeline Get

get.description:
Get the complete unified history of a law across all consolidations.

Returns chronological entries spanning all LBKs and amendments,
with date ranges showing when each version was current.

Each amendment entry includes optional `diff_stats` (change summary)
and `bill` (parliamentary case info) fields.

Use the `paragraph` query parameter to filter to only entries
that modified a specific paragraph.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2017/1002/history
Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2017/1002/history?paragraph=13

parameters.name: paragraph

schema.description: Filter to entries that touch this paragraph (e.g. 2, 2a, 15)
schema.title: Paragraph

parameters.description: Filter to entries that touch this paragraph (e.g. 2, 2a, 15)

get.description:
Get all amendments to a specific law.

Returns a list of laws that have amended this law, along with
the specific paragraph content of each amendment.

Example: /api/v1/laws/2017/1002/amendments

Get all versions of a law.

Returns a list of all historical versions of the law,
ordered by version number (ascending).

Get the latest version of the law with all amendments applied.

By default returns the latest version currently in force. Pass
include_future=true to return the highest-numbered version even if its
effective_date is in the future (e.g. enacted but not yet in force).

Get the latest version of the law as markdown.

Query parameters:
- exclude: Comma-separated sections to exclude
- paragraphs: Paragraph filter ('1-5' for range, '10,15,20' for specific)
- include_future: Include enacted-but-not-yet-in-force versions (default: false)

Get the latest version of the law as PDF.

Query parameters:
- exclude: Comma-separated sections to exclude
- paragraphs: Paragraph filter ('1-5' for range, '10,15,20' for specific)
- include_forarbejder: Include preparatory remarks section (default: false)
- include_future: Include enacted-but-not-yet-in-force versions (default: false)

Get the law as it was on a specific date.

Returns the version that was effective on the given date.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2017/1002/versions/at/2020-01-15

Get the law as it was on a specific date, as markdown.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2017/1002/versions/at/2020-01-15/markdown

Query parameters:
- exclude: Comma-separated sections to exclude
- paragraphs: Paragraph filter ('1-5' for range, '10,15,20' for specific)

Get the law as it was on a specific date, as PDF.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2017/1002/versions/at/2020-01-15/pdf

Query parameters:
- exclude: Comma-separated sections to exclude
- paragraphs: Paragraph filter ('1-5' for range, '10,15,20' for specific)
- include_forarbejder: Include preparatory remarks section (default: false)

Get the diff between two versions of a law.

Returns a list of changes between version v1 and version v2.

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2017/1002/versions/diff/1/3

Get a specific version of a law by version number.

Includes the full structure at that version.

Get a specific version of a law as markdown.

Query parameters:
- exclude: Comma-separated sections to exclude
- paragraphs: Paragraph filter ('1-5' for range, '10,15,20' for specific)

Get a specific version of a law as PDF.

Query parameters:
- exclude: Comma-separated sections to exclude
- paragraphs: Paragraph filter ('1-5' for range, '10,15,20' for specific)
- include_forarbejder: Include preparatory remarks section (default: false)

Get a specific paragraph from the base law (version 1).

Args:
    year: The law year
    number: The law number
    paragraph: The paragraph number (e.g., "1", "15", "15a")

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2025/468/paragraphs/1

Get a specific stk (subsection) from a paragraph in the base law (version 1).

Args:
    year: The law year
    number: The law number
    paragraph: The paragraph number (e.g., "1", "15", "15a")
    stk: The stk number (1-indexed)

Example: /api/v1/lovgivning/2025/468/paragraphs/1/stk/2

Get the full forarbejder timeline for a law.

Includes the law's own preparatory remarks and all amendment forarbejder.

Get the forarbejder timeline for a specific paragraph.

Includes both own and amendment forarbejder targeting this paragraph.

Get full forarbejder timeline for the latest version of a law.

Includes the law's own remarks plus remarks from all amendment laws.

Get forarbejder timeline as it was on a specific date.

Includes the law's own remarks plus amendment remarks with
application_date on or before the target date.

Get forarbejder timeline for a specific version of a law.

Includes the law's own remarks plus amendment remarks up to
that version's effective date.

Paragraph.title: Paragraph
Paragraph.description:
A paragraph (§) in a law document.

Structure:
    All content is stored in the `stk` array. Stk 1 (the implicit
    paragraph text) is stored as stk[0] with number="Stk. 1.".

    Example:
        paragraph.number = "§ 1."
        paragraph.stk = [
            Stk(number="Stk. 1.", text="...", litra=[...]),
            Stk(number="Stk. 2.", text="...", litra=[...]),
        ]

    This provides a uniform structure where amendments can target
    § X, stk. Y, nr. Z consistently.
